about.en: VARA is the native coin of Vara Network, a standalone Substrate-based Layer 1 and the first network built on the Gear Protocol, which runs WebAssembly smart-contract programs using an actor model with persistent memory. VARA pays fees and secures the chain through nominated proof of stake; an ERC-20 representation (0xB67010F2246814e5c39593ac23A925D9e9d7E5aD) circulates on Ethereum.
